These positions are fully remote. Occasional travel to customer sites and events may be required.

Salary is negotiable. Because we are filling several positions, we place each person at a junior, mid, or senior level based on what they bring to the team. Once we see your contributions, we will be upfront about the requirements and pay for that level. If you have a salary requirement, tell us.

Healthcare

At VX, we focus on the person first and build the role around what you bring. Show us what makes you unique: the skills you have built, the problems you love to solve, and the work you are proudest of, whether it came from a job, a classroom, or your own projects.

About The Team:
The Modeling & Simulation team builds the simulation capabilities used to design, integrate, test, and validate advanced aerospace and defense systems. We develop physics-based models, simulation environments, and analysis tools that help engineering teams evaluate system behavior, improve designs, and reduce risk before hardware design, integration, test, and fielding.
About The Role:
As a Modeling & Simulation Engineer for Missiles, you will develop, integrate, and validate dynamic and closed-loop simulations for guided weapons, interceptors, missiles, and related flight vehicles. Programs may include ground-launched and air-launched weapons, tactical or strategic missiles, cruise missiles, ballistic systems, interceptors, hypersonic vehicles, and other advanced effectors.
You will work across fast-running trajectory models, 3-DOF and high-fidelity 6-DOF simulations, software-in-the-loop environments, real-time simulations, and hardware-in-the-loop test systems. You will support vehicle design, GNC and seeker integration, system-performance analysis, verification, test planning, preflight prediction, and postflight reconstruction.
Experience in every area below is not expected; candidates with depth in one or more relevant modeling and simulation domains are encouraged to apply.
What You'll Do:

The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.
The Enterprise Effects Division (EED) drives integration of Aerospace’s strategic capabilities across the national space enterprise. The division leverages a broad array of engineering disciplines against a dynamic portfolio of programs, customers, and national challenges. EED spans the capability lifecycle from concept and architecture design to performance assessment to application of space and space-enabled capabilities.
As a core component of EED, the Emerging Missions Flight Dynamics (EMFD) Department provides flight mechanics expertise for the cislunar domain, multi-objective “traveling salesman” trajectory sequence generation, facility location optimization, and trans-atmospheric flight design for missiles, hyperglide vehicles, and reentry vehicles. Relevant skills include orbital mechanics, astrodynamics, trajectory design and optimization, and atmospheric flight modeling and simulation. The selected candidate will provide expertise for a wide range of customer flight mechanics needs, supporting analysis, research, and development requests. The work will require candidates to provide deep technical solutions while also collaborating with engineering partners to facilitate integrated solutions for our customers’ hardest problems. Customers will include defense, intelligence, and civil and commercial organizations.
The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility in Colorado Springs, CO; El Segundo, CA; Chantilly, VA; or Albuquerque, NM.

Primary Support
Astrodynamics and orbital mechanics analysis including orbit propagation, constellation design and optimization, and maneuver design and optimization for orbit transfer, station keeping, graveyard, disposal, and reentry events
Analysis of combinatorial optimization / sequential decision-making problems, such as the Traveling Salesman Problem, Facility Location Problem, Markov Decision Processes, etc.
Analysis of multi-objective optimization problems leveraging metaheuristic, mathematical programming, deterministic, and optimal control methods
Create, augment, and leverage flight mechanics centric software capabilities as stand-alone tools and ready-to-integrate submodules
Leveraging external tools like SciPy, ASSET, GPOPS-II, SNOPT, POST, OTIS, Copernicus, GMAT, EMTG, etc. where appropriate to augment internally developed capabilities
Evaluate contested missions’ applications for space systems to understand threat performance, assess vulnerabilities, and improve system resiliency
Developing Concepts of Operations (CONOPS), exploring Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), and incorporating operational constraints into the design and maturation of space and near-space systems
Providing operational support for nominal launch and spacecraft deployment and transfer sequences, anomaly resolution, and on-call emerging events
Additional Inter-department Partnership Collaborations Opportunities
Maneuver and orbit design, selection, and optimization for missions that support Rendezvous and Proximity Operations (RPO) objectives with complex operational constraints
Cislunar and exploration-class orbital mechanics analysis and trajectory optimization
Hypersonics, missiles, interceptors, and reentry vehicle trajectory design and optimization
Analysis of vehicles with chemical and/or electric propulsion
Trajectory design and optimization for launch vehicles and spacecraft for missions operating in LEO, MEO, HEO, GEO, and other earth-centric regimes

Optical Communications Software Engineer – Modem Integration
Bright Silicon Technologies | Pleasanton, CA | Full time
About The Role
Bright Silicon Technologies (BST) develops precision optical systems built around our Lightfield Directing Array (LDA), a MEMS micromirror array for fast, precise control of light. Our OCTANE free-space optical communications terminal brings together free-space optics, fiber-based photonics, and communications hardware to enable high-bandwidth links between ground and airborne platforms.
We’re looking for a software engineer to own modem integration and communications software for OCTANE. You’ll build the software that configures and monitors our (expected to be a COMET) modem, connects it to the terminal’s data interfaces, and manages link operation and recovery. Working with our photonics, firmware, controls, and hardware engineers, you’ll take a working laboratory system toward reliable outdoor and mobile operation, targeting Space Development Agency (SDA) interoperability.
What you’ll do
Own modem software integration for our free space optical communications terminal. Develop C/C++ software for modem configuration, telemetry, host interfaces, network interface and data transfer.
Define software interfaces and acceptance criteria, including applicable SDA Optical Communications Terminal (OCT) requirements. Coordinate link states and timing with pointing, acquisition, and tracking (PAT) software.
Implement link state machines, startup and shutdown sequences, fault handling, and recovery after fades or interruptions.
Build Python tools and automated bench and hardware-in-the-loop tests. Measure throughput, latency, packet loss, and bit error rate to verify link performance.
Troubleshoot problems across software, embedded interfaces, modem behavior, interfaces with the next level up in the network, and optical performance
What we’re looking for
A bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, and at least three years of modem integration and communications software development experience.
Strong C/C++ skills and experience developing and debugging software on Linux or real-time embedded platforms.
Hands-on experience integrating communications hardware and debugging hardware/software interfaces using logs, telemetry, protocol captures, and laboratory measurements.
Experience using Python or a similar language for test automation and data analysis, with working knowledge of communications performance measurements.
U.S. citizenship.
Nice to have
Experience with SDA OCT standards, compliant optical terminals, or modem and terminal interoperability testing.
Experience with COMET or other optical communications modems, including configuration, telemetry, and host integration.
Experience with free-space or fiber-optic communications, including optical link budgets, receiver sensitivity, and the effects of changing received power.
Familiarity with communications or modem DSP, including modulation, synchronization, framing, forward error correction, or equalization.
Experience integrating software with FPGA-based systems, including register interfaces and data paths.
Experience validating link state machines and fault recovery through hardware-in-the-loop testing or field demonstrations on mobile platforms.
Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At BST we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
Why BST
Own the software that connects OCTANE’s modem and terminal hardware into a working optical communications link, from bench integration through outdoor testing.
Work closely with colleagues in photonics, firmware, controls, and electronics. Follow problems across interfaces and see the results in operating hardware.
Take meaningful technical ownership in an engineer-led company with competitive compensation, equity, and a sustainable approach to work.
Company Overview
At Bright, we build precision optical systems to guide data for a new era of communication. Our team combines precision engineering, optical design, and product development to commercialize the Lightfield Directing Array. Applications include laser communications, optical switching for data centers, lidar, and additive manufacturing.
Founded in 2020, Bright Silicon Technologies is building an enduring technology manufacturing company. You’ll contribute to the development, launch, and scaling of advanced optical products. We offer competitive salaries and equity incentives, and we value effective engineering alongside long-term work/life balance.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Generous paid time off and paid company holidays

About Us:
Data Panel is a small and dynamic subsidiary specializing in the design and manufacture of embedded electronic control systems for mobile equipment. Data Panel is based in Plymouth, MN and a subsidiary of Murrelektronik, a global automation company based in Oppenweiller, Germany with US headquarters in Atlanta, Georgia. Our control solutions serve both on-road vehicles, such as utility and emergency vehicles, and off-road machines, such as construction and agricultural machinery.
Job Summary:
We are looking for a resourceful, hands-on engineer
(based in or near Plymouth, MN)
with a broad technical background, the kind of person whose experience may span from PCB design, firmware, scripting, and bench work rather than deep specialization in one area. You should be equal parts builder and tester, comfortable reading a schematic one moment and writing a Pytest script the next. In this role, you will develop automated test solutions for embedded electronic control systems, build and adapt automated test fixtures, and help establish our validation and documentation practices. You will also perform manual testing, troubleshooting, and board-level rework as needed, with the goal of increasing automation over time.
Key Responsibilities:
Test Automation & Fixture Development
Write and maintain automated test scripts in Python
Help develop and adapt an automated test fixture for current and future products
Integrate test automation with embedded hardware interfaces and communication protocols
Continuously improve test coverage and execution efficiency, manual Testing & Troubleshooting
Perform manual functional testing of embedded electronic control systems, including power systems, communication, and I/O verification
Troubleshoot PCBA failures and anomalies using oscilloscopes, multimeters, and bench power supplies
Perform board-level rework and repair as needed
Document test results, failure modes, and root cause findings
Documentation & Process Development
Create and maintain test plans, test cases, and test reports following V-model methodology
Help establish validation and verification documentation practices and templates where none currently exist
Support the evaluation and implementation of requirements management software to trace specifications to requirements and test cases to specifications
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field
3-5+years of work experience testing embedded electronics, writing firmware, or designing PCBAs
Ability to read and interpret electrical PCBA schematics
Experience with Python or other scripting languages and a desire to learn more
Electronics troubleshooting and rework experience
Willingness to work in an environment where processes and documentation templates are still being established
Proficiency with standard electronics lab equipment (oscilloscope, multimeter, bench power supply)
Generalist mindset with a willingness to wear multiple hats across testing, scripting, troubleshooting, and documentation.
Preferred Qualifications
:
5+ years of work experience testing embedded electronics (Test Engineer II level)
Experience with Pytest testing framework
Experience with automated functional testing and test fixture development
Experience with V-model validation and verification methodology
Experience with requirements documentation and traceability (linking specifications to requirements and test cases to specifications)
Firmware development experience, even at the hobbyist level (Arduino, Raspberry Pi, or similar)
PCBA design experience
Experience with CANbus protocols (J1939 or CANopen)
Experience evaluating or implementing requirements management software
Work Hours:
M-F Flexible
Work Location:
Plymouth, MN (Onsite)

title: 2027 Trajectory Optimization Engineer
reason: No visa sponsorship or requires citizenship/clearance
reject_reason: No visa sponsorship or requires citizenship/clearance
description_preview:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.
The Enterprise Effects Division (EED) drives integration of Aerospace’s strategic capabilities across the national space enterprise. The division leverages a broad array of engineering disciplines against a dynamic portfolio of programs, customers, and national challenges. EED spans the capability lifecycle from concept and architecture design to performance assessment to application of space and space-enabled capabilities.
As a core component of EED, the Emerging Missions Flight Dynamics (EMFD) Department provides flight mechanics expertise for the cislunar domain, multi-objective “traveling salesman” trajectory sequence generation, facility location optimization, and trans-atmospheric flight design for missiles, hyperglide vehicles, and reentry vehicles. Relevant skills include orbital mechanics, astrodynamics, trajectory design and optimization, and atmospheric flight modeling and simulation. The selected candidate will provide expertise for a wide range of customer flight mechanics needs, supporting analysis, research, and development requests. The work will require candidates to provide deep technical solutions while also collaborating with engineering partners to facilitate integrated solutions for our customers’ hardest problems. Customers will include defense, intelligence, and civil and commercial organizations.
The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility in Colorado Springs, CO; El Segundo, CA; Chantilly, VA; or Albuquerque, NM.
What You’ll Be Doing
Primary Support
Astrodynamics and orbital mechanics analysis including orbit propagation, constellation design and optimization, and maneuver design and optimization for orbit transfer, station keeping, graveyard, disposal, and reentry events
Analysis of combinatorial optimization / sequential decision-making problems, such as the Traveling Salesman Problem, Facility Location Problem, Markov Decision Processes, etc.
Analysis of multi-objective optimization problems leveraging metaheuristic, mathematical programming, deterministic, and optimal control methods
Create, augment, and leverage flight mechanics centric software capabilities as stand-alone tools and ready-to-integrate submodules
Leveraging external tools like SciPy, ASSET, GPOPS-II, SNOPT, POST, OTIS, Copernicus, GMAT, EMTG, etc. where appropriate to augment internally developed capabilities
Evaluate contested missions’ applications for space systems to understand threat performance, assess vulnerabilities, and improve system resiliency
Developing Concepts of Operations (CONOPS), exploring Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), and incorporating operational constraints into the design and maturation of space and near-space systems
Providing operational support for nominal launch and spacecraft deployment and transfer sequences, anomaly resolution, and on-call emerging events
Additional Inter-department Partnership Collaborations Opportunities
Maneuver and orbit design, selection, and optimization for missions that support Rendezvous and Proximity Operations (RPO) objectives with complex operational constraints
Cislunar and exploration-class orbital mechanics analysis and trajectory optimization
Hypersonics, missiles, interceptors, and reentry vehicle trajectory design and optimization
Analysis of vehicles with chemical and/or electric propulsion
Trajectory design and optimization for launch vehicles and spacecraft for missions operating in LEO, MEO, HEO, GEO, and other earth-centric regimes
Duties, responsibilities and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned as needed
What Corporate Skills You’ll Bring
Strong written and oral communication skills
Must work well in a team environment
Must possess strong organizational, time management, and project management skills
Demonstrate flexibility and ability to adapt to changing organizational need
Interpersonal skills to coordinate efforts and work with other internal and external organizations
Minimum Requirements
What You Need to be Successful
Master's degree from an accredited college/university program in aeronautical/astronautical engineering, physics or applied mathematics, or related technical discipline (pursuing or conferred within last 12 months)
0-1 year of industry work experience
Experience in one or more of the following subjects: space mission analysis and design, advanced astrodynamics, algorithm design, software development, mathematical modeling, multi-objective optimization, decision making under uncertainty, and/or trajectory simulation and performance optimization
Proficiency with one or more of the following programming languages/tools: Python, C/C++, Fortran, MATLAB.
Willing to travel domestically to customer and contractor facilities (approx. 10%)
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance, which is issued by the US government. U.S citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.
Transcripts

Our platform enables marketers to import and consolidate data from all of their marketing tools and channels, and lets them easily export their data to data warehouses (e.g. Amazon Web Services / Redshift) and analysis tools like Google Sheets, Google Data Studio and visualization tools. Since the product launch in 2015, we have set up offices in Stockholm, Boston, and Sydney, and have grown to service thousands of marketers all over the world, with the US as the largest market. We strive for the work environment to be fun, friendly and fulfilling. We believe that psychological safety and individual development are core components that are needed for building successful organizations.
About The Role
The Integration Engineering team is responsible for supporting Funnel's customers with their data use cases and the integrations they need for getting data into and out of the Funnel product. When a customer needs data imported to Funnel from a source that is not supported by Funnel's "out-of-the-box" integrations, they come to Integration Engineering for a custom-made solution. In other words, the team helps customers set up custom data extraction, configures the import of data in the Funnel platform, and troubleshoots customer problems with the integrations that we have built for them.
As an Integration Engineer, you are a key contributor to ensuring that our customers get maximum value out of Funnel. It is a unique type of role in a team that frequently interacts with Commercial and Product Development teams at Funnel.

Code: Python, JavaScript, SQL

Testing: Postman
Cloud services: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
Databases and SQL: Postgres, MySQL, BigQuery
Customer Comms: Hubspot, Intercom

You are comfortable working in customer-facing roles, and you enjoy being a helpful resource and solving other people's problems

Experience in writing code, either through education or work

This role requires a self-driven individual who is proactive in staying current with emerging technologies and can participate in efforts effectively with a small team of developers.

Develop, maintain, and enhance Golang Teamcenter libraries, NX ufunc, Capital Harness DRC libraries among other reusable and extensible codebase.

About Agile Defense
At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.
Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.
Job Title:
MSS Developer Engineer
Location:
O'Fallon (St. Louis), IL: Scott AFB
Clearance Level:
This position requires candidates to be U.S. citizens and to possess, at minimum, an active Secret security clearance. Roles under this requisition may require higher-level clearances, including TS/SCI, which candidates must be able to obtain and maintain based on project assignment.
Job Description
Build Mission-Critical Analytics and Applications
Build and maintain operator-facing dashboards, applications, and decision surfaces aligned to J7 mission workflows
Create intuitive, self-service capabilities that empower operators to explore data independently
Build automated workflows that deliver timely insights to stakeholders across the directorate
Ensure data accuracy and consistency across all MSS deliverables
Drive Hands-On Platform Engineering
Develop and maintain data pipelines, ontology, and access controls on MSS and the underlying Palantir stack
Integrate external data sources into a well-modeled data foundation
Ensure AI/AIP workflows have a well-modeled data foundation and that model outputs are surfaced in operationally useful ways
Partner with mission leaders to understand analytical needs and translate requirements into technical solutions
Enable Data-Driven Decision Making
Create compelling data visualizations that communicate complex insights to diverse audiences
Build interactive tools that allow operators to drill down into data and explore different scenarios
Design alerting and monitoring systems that proactively identify mission opportunities and risks
Collaborate with teams to establish KPIs and success metrics that drive mission performance
Optimize Platform Performance
Develop efficient data models and query optimization strategies for fast, reliable reporting Implement caching and aggregation strategies to ensure optimal dashboard and application performance
Build scalable MSS solutions that can handle growing data volumes and user bases
Provide day-to-day operator support and escalate complex platform issues to senior engineers as appropriate
Foster Analytics Excellence
Contribute reusable platform content, including ontology patterns, dashboard templates, and integration recipes, to support continuous curriculum refresh Document data sources, metrics definitions, and analytical methodologies for organizational knowledge
Support validation of the FDE&T model for potential extension to additional Combatant Commands, Service components, and functional commands
Stay current with MSS/Palantir technologies and advocate for new tools and approaches that improve mission analytics
Required Skills
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a quantitative discipline; extensive Palantir experience will substitute.
4+ years of software or data engineering experience (data analysis or data science experience considered), including 1.5+ years hands-on with Palantir Foundry, Gotham, AIP, or MSS
Demonstrated experience building dashboards, applications, or pipelines for operational end users
Working proficiency in ontology design, pipeline authoring using PySpark, Code Repositories, or Pipeline Builder
Active US government security clearance
Preferred Skills
Prior Palantir FDE/FDSE or comparable customer-embedded role
Hands-on MSS experience AIP agent or large language model workflow exposure
Familiarity with DoD data environments and classified networks
Prior Combatant Command support
Solid Python and SQL skills with familiarity in JavaScript/TypeScript
Working Conditions
Must be able to work onsite in a SCIF
Our Core Values
Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. Agile Defense has been highly successful in the past few years due to our employees and the culture we create together.
What makes us Agile? We call it the 6Hs, the values that define our culture and guide everything we do. Together, these values infuse vibrancy, integrity, and a tireless work ethic into advancing the most important national security and critical civilian missions. It's how we show up every day. It's who we are.
Happy
-
Be Infectious.
Happiness multiplies and creates a positive and connected environment where motivation and satisfaction have an outsized effect on everything we do.
Helpful
-
Be Supportive.
Being helpful is the foundation of teamwork, resulting in a supportive atmosphere where collaboration flourishes, and collective success is celebrated.
Honest
-
Be Trustworthy.
Honesty serves as our compass, ensuring transparent communication and ethical conduct, essential to who we are and the complex domains we support.
Humble
-
Be Grounded.
Success is not achieved alone, humility ensures a culture of mutual respect, encouraging open communication, and a willingness to learn from one another and take on any task.
Hungry

About The Role
OpenGov is seeking a Product Engineer II to take on increasing ownership of a product area with cross-functional exposure. This role is for developing practitioners who can contribute to discovery, roadmap input, and delivery with general direction from a lead, while growing their ability to operate independently. AI-native tooling accelerates execution — your job is to direct it toward the right outcomes for customers.
How AI Works in This Role
AI-native Tooling Handles a Significant Portion Of What Product Managers And UX Designers Have Historically Spent Their Time On. That Time Is Yours To Redirect Toward Higher-leverage Work. Specifically
Spec writing: AI drafts the first spec from your intent statement. You review, sharpen, and own what gets built.
UX design: AI generates mockups from the design system based on your flow definitions. Experience Architects maintain the system itself. You make the product decisions within it.
Research synthesis: AI clusters and themes interview notes, call transcripts, and support data. You interpret what it means for the roadmap and make the call.
Release content: AI generates release notes, in-app announcements, and enablement materials from your shipped features.
Code review: Automated review catches style, security, and regression issues. You stay accountable for quality outcomes — not the review queue.
Test coverage: AI generates test cases from the acceptance criteria you write. Your job is to write criteria that are precise enough to verify.
Competitive intelligence: AI monitors competitor moves and surfaces market signals. You form the point of view and decide what it means for your roadmap.
What AI does not do: understand your customers, make the call on what matters, own the outcome, or build the cross-functional trust that makes things ship. That is the job.
What You'll Own
Define and communicate the product vision for your area — grounded in customer research, competitive context, and business goals; not inherited from committee.
Conduct and synthesize customer discovery: translate what you hear into clear, defensible decisions about what to build and what to cut.
Own the product roadmap: prioritize ruthlessly, explain your reasoning publicly, and revise it when new facts warrant it.
Define user experience flows and interaction patterns within the design system; escalate to Experience Architects when genuinely new system-level patterns are required.
Write clear intent documents that AI tooling can execute against; review and own AI-generated specs for accuracy, completeness, and correctness.
Partner with engineering to unblock builds, resolve ambiguity in real time, and make decisions during the development cycle without becoming a bottleneck.
Track adoption, usage, and business outcome metrics; use them to drive the next iteration, not just to report status.
Represent your product in customer conversations, QBRs, and cross-functional reviews — the full commercial picture, not just the feature set.
Identify gaps in AI harnesses and design system coverage; surface them as platform investment requests with clear business justification.
Qualifications & Preferred Experience
2–4 years of experience in product management, software engineering, or a closely adjacent technical role.
Ability to contribute to and navigate cross-functional engineering projects, with awareness of how your work connects to system architecture and broader team goals.
Experience conducting customer or stakeholder interviews, or translating technical requirements and user research into actionable engineering specs.
Solid written and verbal communication; can explain technical tradeoffs clearly, provide project updates, and incorporate feedback at key milestones.
Adapts to changing priorities and demonstrates a track record of shipping reliably.
Developing comfort with AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., AI-assisted coding, code review, or testing tools); willingness to become proficient is required.
Familiarity with design systems, component-based architecture, or API/data modeling is a plus.
Experience with modern SaaS architecture (APIs, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD) preferred..
How This Level Is Differentiated
The following competency behaviors distinguish this level from adjacent ones:
Contributes to cross-functional projects and adapts to changing needs; viewed as a reliable team member.
Provides regular updates and receives feedback at key milestones; developing strong listening and communication skills.
Understands specific functional areas and applies expertise to contribute to company goals.
Works within their function and occasionally interfaces in cross-program relationships.
Identifies and articulates problems, extracts simple insights, and proposes solutions within scope.
Compensation
Boston, MA: $110,000 - $125,000
On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.
The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.
